name: firediff
description: Show who a Firestore security rules change just let in.

scripts.build: tsup && ncc build .build/bin.js -o dist/cli -q --license licenses.txt && ncc build .build/action.js -o dist/action -q --license licenses.txt
scripts.test:emulator: scripts/java21.sh firebase emulators:exec --only firestore --project demo-firediff "vitest run"
scripts.traps: scripts/java21.sh firebase emulators:exec --only firestore --project demo-firediff "tsx scripts/traps.ts"
